hero.subtitle: Australian sovereign and senior bank bonds, actively managed to preserve capital and earn income through the rate cycle.

about.title: About the Fund
about.body: Every holding in the Fund is Australian sovereign or senior bank paper — the most liquid, highest-quality end of the domestic bond market. The discipline is structural: no leverage, no structured credit, no foreign currency. Net asset value was $38.7 million as at 30 April 2026.

performance.title: Performance
performance.note: Returns to 31 August 2026, annualised and net of all fees. Cash distributions were 3.71% over the year and have averaged 2.81% p.a. since inception. Past performance is not an indicator of future performance.
performance.tableNote: Fund returns are net of all fees, calculated using exit prices and assuming distributions are reinvested, with no allowance for tax. The distribution component is the amount paid by way of distribution, including net realised capital gains. Numbers may not sum due to rounding.

whoItMaySuit.title: Who it may suit
whoItMaySuit.body: Investors seeking a defensive, income-focused allocation with low to medium risk over a one to three-year horizon — the stable core of a client portfolio, SMSF income without equity-style drawdowns, or organisational reserves that must stay liquid.

howManaged.title: How the Fund is managed
body: Income is earned by reading the rate cycle, not by reaching for yield. Positioning across sovereign and senior bank paper follows conviction about where rates and credit margins are heading — never an index weight.

The Fund’s universe is eligible collateral for RBA repurchase operations, a liquidity backstop most private-sector instruments can’t offer. Every decision passes four-eyes governance before it settles, with operational oversight independent of the investment desk.
